create_test_suite: create a CTestSuiteBase instance with a name, suite path, and run path
load_settings_from_config: load settings from a settings.cfg JSON file into the test suite object
get_settings_item: get a specific settings item by key from the test suite settings dictionary
run_suite_setup: run the on_suite_setup hook to initialize the test suite before tests
run_suite_cleanup: run the on_suite_cleanup hook to clean up the test suite after tests
